relevance_note: Multicentre case series of 11 people with LAMP2 variants, each described individually in Tables 1-3 ("This study included 11 LAMP2 cases").
method_note:
Worked from Table 1 (demographics and variants), Table 2 (symptoms and signs), Table 3 (RORR sign extent) and the text; a Python script in my scratch directory built the JSON and cut table-row spans from the Markdown lines; I checked every transcribed cell against the tables by eye.
TABLE 1 IS TRANSPOSED AND GARBLED IN THE CONVERSION (patients are columns; the header column also holds case 1's value in some rows), and its rows are not aligned the same way. I aligned each row by the ID row and the text: (a) ID, coding-variant, refraction and visual-acuity rows: case 1 is in the first (label) cell ('ID 1', 'FFA Coding variant a c.427del') and case k is in data column k-1; this is confirmed by the text for case 3 (array deletion), case 4 (insertion), case 7 (large deletion), case 9 (nonsense, c.718C>T), cases 5 and 11 (same family, same variant c.928G>A) and case 6 (c.928G>A). (b) Age, Sex, Country and Protein rows: data column 1 holds two values for cases 1 and 2 ('14 12', 'Female Female', 'UK UK', 'p.(Ile143Serfs*5) p.(Thr347Profs*4)') and case k (3-11) is in column k-1; confirmed by the text (16-year-old male case 3, 52-year-old female case 11). (c) Family-history row: case k is in column k for cases 1-9 and the last column holds two values for cases 10 and 11; confirmed by the 'Negative Somatic mosaic by NGS' cells falling on cases 3 and 6, the two isolated de novo mosaic cases in the text.
Stacked cells (v6): the age cell '14 12' and the protein cell 'p.(Ile143Serfs*5) p.(Thr347Profs*4)' hold two people's values; I did not assign them by position, so age and protein are not reported for cases 1 and 2. 'Female Female' and 'UK UK' carry the same value for both, so sex female and country UK were recorded for cases 1 and 2 (sex also supported by 'Case 3, the only male'). Refraction and visual-acuity values were not used (not schema fields; myopia is stated only as a cohort mean, so the myopia checklist item is not reported).
Labels: 'case <n>' as the text uses it ('case 3', 'case 11'); Table 1 'ID' and Table 2/3 'Case ID' use the same numbers.
Variants: transcript NM_002294.3 from Table 1 footnote a (applies to the coding variants; not given for case 3's array deletion). Pathogenicity 'pathogenic' from the named-group statement 'We recruited 11 cases with pathogenic variants in LAMP2'. Variant types only where the text names the case (case 3 and 7 large deletions, case 9 nonsense, case 4 'insertions' recorded as 'other', cases 5 and 11 splice, case 6 splice-site wording); the four small deletions are not named, so cases 1, 2, 8 and 10 are 'not reported'. Zygosity 'mosaic' for cases 3 and 6 (Table 1 'Somatic mosaic by NGS', text 'de novo somatic mosaicism', case 6 '9-10% of the reads', case 3 'presumed mosaic'). Case 6 is de novo (both parents tested negative). Case 3 is called 'de novo' without any stated parental testing, so inheritance is 'not reported' (rule 8). 'Positive Germline' family history was not turned into an inheritance value.
Phenotypes: HCM recorded as left ventricular hypertrophy and DCM as dilated left ventricle on the checklist. 'No skeletal muscle weakness' (all 11) excludes the proximal muscle weakness item. 'Normal intellect' is recorded as intellectual disability excluded (D-27), but the composite checklist item (intellectual disability, cognitive impairment or learning difficulties) is left 'not reported' because learning difficulties are not addressed. 'No history of cardiac disease' (cases 2, 5, 6) and 'None' for ocular or systemic symptoms are recorded as written (broad negatives) and exclude nothing more specific. Table 2 'N/A' and empty cells are not reported. Pigmentary retinopathy or retinal dystrophy is observed for all 11 from 'Eleven cases ... with a clinical and molecular diagnosis of LAMP2-associated retinopathy' (group statement), and stated individually for cases 3 and 11 (most pronounced pigmented streaks). RORR sign observed for the nine cases listed in Table 3 (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10). Pacemaker implantation (case 4) was not read as atrioventricular block, and 'fibrotic changes of the left ventricle' (case 4) was not read as late gadolinium enhancement. Age-of-onset values in Table 2 have no unit in the header; I converted them as years.
Contradiction/inconsistency: case 8 has 'Age of symptom onset' 28 but 'heart transplantation at 24 years' (age 31 in Table 1); both recorded as printed.
Previously published people: three from Schorderet et al., 2007 (2 hemizygous males, 1 female carrier) and one from Meinert et al., 2019 (heterozygous female with a mosaic LAMP2 variant), each with sex and pigmentary retinopathy; variant rows kept with variant 'not reported'. The Schorderet sentence does not itself name LAMP2; the gene comes from the paragraph's context. Cases 7-10 (Kousal et al., 2021) and 5 and 11 (Yang et al., 2024) were previously reported; recorded in publications, and source_reference_in_review left 'not reported' because these are the authors' own cases described first-hand. Comparison subjects (choroideremia and ocular albinism carriers, healthy control, donor eye) are out of scope.
